terms.gloss: by the way, in passing, incidentally
evidence: Plin. NH praef. 28: ut obiter caveam istōs Homēromastīgās (Lewis & Short s.v. Homēromastīx)
terms.comment: Literally “on the way”. Lewis & Short: not before Augustus except in Laberius; Augustus preferred it to per viam.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 110.: p. 285.
